---
name: onboarding-buddy
description: >-
  Guide a new joiner through onboarding to ANY project and track their progress
  across sessions. Use when the user says "onboard me to <project>", "I'm new to
  <project>", "where do I start", "continue my onboarding", "what's next", "mark
  this step done", or "I'm stuck on <step>". Project-blind: reads the project's
  onboarding/curriculum.yaml and writes the user's private L2 progress file.
  Triggers on "onboard me", "I'm new here", "where do I start", "continue
  onboarding", "what's next in onboarding".
tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write, Edit
model: sonnet
